comparisons_not_made: Care tiers are not compared with each other: families at different tiers use different carrier phrases and target words, so their endpoints are probabilities of different tokens in different contexts.
Strata are not pooled: a register contrast, a patient-explanation contrast and a syntax crossing are different manipulations.

design.status: draft, 2026-11-12: proposed by the batch-intake change; not agreed. The owner agrees it by a commit that changes this line.

eligibility_rules.confirmatory: A held-out family's register contrast can enter a confirmatory statement only when none of the blockers in confirmatory_blockers applies. The protocol draft names the signed protocol, the two reviews, the single manipulated dimension and the split made before measurement. The owner's keep, the open-concern rule and the named stem are criteria this design adds; the owner agrees or removes them with the rest of this file.

confirmatory_blockers.calibration_split: the family is in discovery, which calibrates thresholds and is never part of a confirmatory statement
confirmatory_blockers.clinician_review_missing: no clinician has recorded all six dimensions on this version of the family
confirmatory_blockers.domain_review_not_passed: the rubric's status rule does not give 'reviewed': the clinician did not record 'same' on all six dimensions (a 'cannot_judge' is not 'same'), or a review is missing
confirmatory_blockers.exploratory_stratum: the family has a flag (a dialect form, or a carrier with no earlier measurement), so its register contrast changes more than register
confirmatory_blockers.open_concern_on_register_pair: an open concern applies to the family or to its register contrast. Added by this design
confirmatory_blockers.owner_read: the owner has not kept this version of the family (not_read, excluded or stale). Added by this design; the owner's read is not a domain review and does not replace one
confirmatory_blockers.patient_language_review_missing: no patient-language reviewer has recorded both items on this version of the family
confirmatory_blockers.protocol_not_signed: the protocol's status does not begin with the word 'signed'
confirmatory_blockers.removed_by_review: a reviewer recorded 'different' on an item
confirmatory_blockers.software_validation_failed: the family has a structural error
confirmatory_blockers.split_timing_not_verified: the stem has a run directory, so the command cannot verify that the split was recorded first
confirmatory_blockers.stem_not_named: no stem was named, so the command has not looked for measurements. Added by this design

eligibility_rules.publication: docs/open_results_policy.md: an intact result of a hand-authored family is shared under public-display/1 whatever its effect, with its evidence class and review status shown. Publication does not need the reviews; it needs the labels.

endpoint.definition: the full-vocabulary probability of the first token of the family's declared target word at the position after the carrier phrase
is_not: evidence that a model understands a wording
endpoint.name: first_token_probability
endpoint.partial_when: the target word is more than one token; the endpoint then reads its first token only and is labelled partial

behavioural_pass_owner_kept.rates_source: scripts/backfill_planner.py SECONDS_PER_PAIR: the SLOWEST rate each model showed in its successful logits-eval runs on GitHub Actions up to 2026-10-09: the 'Measure next-token behavior' step's duration (model load included) over the pairs the run's trigger file asked for. mechanistic_subset.ica_basis: one fitted basis per model, fitted on discovery families only, used unchanged for every register and every stratum
mechanistic_subset.rule: A method states which alignment classes it reads. A family is never rewritten to reach a class: unnatural patient wording is a worse defect than a coarser alignment.
mechanistic_subset.selection: a seeded draw of families, made before any measurement of the batch, from owner-kept discovery families in the register stratum without flags; care levels are visited in turn. Held-out families are not drawn: a mechanism developed on them could not be confirmed on them.
